title: ID60013: Thermal
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Analysis of steam power cycles: reheat and regeneration, combined cycle plants,
cogeneration, boilers, different types of circulation, supercritical boilers.
Down-comers and risers, drum and its internals, economizers and super-heaters,
air pre-heater.
Steam turbines, types, losses, condensers. air-extraction systems, feed water
heaters, de-aerators. cooling towers. environmental pollution and its control.
Basic concepts of reactor physics, types of reactors: BWR, PWR, PHWR, GCR and
LMCR.
Containment system, reactor safety and radiation shields, Waste management.
Indian nuclear power programme.
Hydel power: stream flow data and water-power estimate, hydraulic turbines:
different types and their characteristics, guideline for selection, draft tube,
penstock, cavitation; Plant layout, costing of water power, environmental
impact.
